# watchpoint_status_page_maintenance (Resource)

Planned work announced on a status page, optionally recurring. Every instant is UTC. This is the status-page announcement, not the monitor-pausing window: use `watchpoint_maintenance_window` to pause monitors. A recurring window is materialised one occurrence ahead by the server, and this resource owns the first occurrence and the rule on it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One-off window.
resource "watchpoint_status_page_maintenance" "db_upgrade" {
  status_page_id       = watchpoint_status_page.example.id
  title                = "Database upgrade"
  description_markdown = "We are moving the primary database to a larger instance. Expect brief write errors."
  scheduled_start_at   = "2026-07-04T02:00:00Z"
  scheduled_end_at     = "2026-07-04T04:00:00Z"
  component_ids        = [watchpoint_status_page_component.api.id]
}

# Recurring window: every other week on Monday and Wednesday at 02:00 UTC,
# for twelve occurrences.
resource "watchpoint_status_page_maintenance" "patching" {
  status_page_id     = watchpoint_status_page.example.id
  title              = "Routine patching"
  scheduled_start_at = "2026-07-06T02:00:00Z"
  scheduled_end_at   = "2026-07-06T03:00:00Z"
  suppress_alerts    = true
  component_ids      = [watchpoint_status_page_component.api.id]

  recurrence_frequency = "Weekly"
  recurrence_interval  = 2
  recurrence_by_day    = ["MO", "WE"]
  recurrence_count     = 12
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scheduled_end_at` (String) Window end (RFC 3339, UTC). Must be after `scheduled_start_at`, and for a recurring window must be shorter than the gap between occurrences.
- `scheduled_start_at` (String) Window start (RFC 3339, UTC). For a recurring window this is the first occurrence.
- `status_page_id` (String) ID of the status page this window is announced on. Changing it replaces the window.
- `title` (String) Window title shown to visitors, for example `Database upgrade`.

### Optional

- `component_ids` (Set of String) Components this work affects. Unordered. Drives both what the public page marks as under maintenance and, with `suppress_alerts`, which monitors stay quiet.
- `description_markdown` (String) Markdown body rendered under the maintenance banner on the public page.
- `recurrence_by_day` (Set of String) Weekly recurrence only: the weekdays the window falls on, as `SU`, `MO`, `TU`, `WE`, `TH`, `FR`, `SA`. Unordered. Omit to repeat on the same weekday as the first occurrence. The API clears this for any frequency other than `Weekly`, so setting it alongside `Daily` or `Monthly` will fail the apply.
- `recurrence_count` (Number) Total number of occurrences in the series, including the first. Omit for unbounded.
- `recurrence_frequency` (String) How often the window repeats: `None`, `Daily`, `Weekly`, `Monthly`. Defaults to `None`, a one-off window.
- `recurrence_interval` (Number) Repeat every N periods, so `2` with `Weekly` is fortnightly. Between 1 and 52. Defaults to `1`.
- `recurrence_until` (String) Stop repeating once the next occurrence would start after this instant (RFC 3339, UTC). Must be after `scheduled_start_at`. Omit for no end date.
- `suppress_alerts` (Boolean) Skip alert notifications for the monitors behind `component_ids` while the window is running. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `actual_end_at` (String) When the window actually ended (RFC 3339), once it has.
- `actual_start_at` (String) When the window actually started (RFC 3339), once it has.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Maintenance window ID.
- `status` (String) Current window status (`Scheduled`, `InProgress`, `Completed`, `Cancelled`). Driven by the server, not configurable: cancelling a window is done in the portal.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_status_page_maintenance.db_upgrade page_001/maintenance_001
```
